description_expanded:
Stones Throw To The Sea | Watercolor, FL

58 Pine Needle Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Nestled in WaterColor's desirable Forest District, Stones Throw To The Sea | 58 Pine Needle Way is a beautifully designed luxury retreat just steps from Camp WaterColor. Surrounded by the community's nature preserve, this spacious vacation rental home offers multiple covered balconies with peaceful wooded views, inviting indoor and outdoor living spaces, and the perfect setting for unforgettable family vacations along Scenic Highway 30A. Enjoy 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and enough room for 8 friends and family members.

From the moment you arrive, you'll feel immersed in the beauty that makes WaterColor so unique. Expansive porches overlook the nature preserve, creating a peaceful backdrop for your stay. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee surrounded by nature or relaxing after a day at the beach, the home's outdoor living spaces invite you to slow down and enjoy every moment. At the heart of the home, the open-concept kitchen, dining area, and living room provide an ideal gathering place for family and friends. Thoughtfully designed for entertaining, the chef's kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious living area, making everything from casual breakfasts before heading to Camp WaterColor to evening dinners at home feel effortless.

Designed with both comfort and privacy in mind, the home's thoughtfully arranged bedrooms provide inviting retreats after a day of exploring 30A. Spacious suites and welcoming gathering spaces ensure everyone has room to relax while still enjoying quality time together. The first floor treats you to one guest bedroom with a king size bed and bathroom with a shower/tub combo for your convenience. The second floor offers the remaining bedrooms and multiple balconies. The first bedroom is the master retreat that is complete with a plush king size bed, private bathroom with a tiled walk-in shower, and beautiful views of the nature preserve. The last bedroom offers a queen size bed and two twin single built-ins. There is an additional bathroom on this floor with a shower/tub combo and a laundry room with a full size washer and dryer.

Outside, guests can spend the day at nearby Camp WaterColor, explore the community by bike, or simply unwind on one of the home's covered balconies overlooking the nature preserve. Whether you're relaxing beneath the trees, heading to the beach, or discovering everything WaterColor has to offer, Stones Throw To The Sea provides the perfect home base for your next 30A getaway.

*Built in coffee maker is not available for guest usage

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 8

3 Bedrooms

3 Baths

1900 Square Feet

Close to Camp Watercolor

Multiple Covered Balconies

Nature Preserve Views

Easy Access to Watercolor Publix

3 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

Parking for 2 Vehicles

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

8 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor

- Spacious open concept living room, kitchen and dining table

- Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances

- Stylish dining table with seating for 6 guests and bar stool seating for 2 guests

- Screened in porch with nature preserve views

- Access to outdoor patio and grilling area

- Guest bedroom with a king size bed and bathroom with a shower/tub combo

Second Floor

- Master bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Guest bedroom with a queen size bed and two built-in twin singles with access to a bathroom with a shower/tub combo

- Access to multiple balconies with nature preserve views

- Laundry room with full size washer and dryer

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 Vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served basis. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 8 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
